name: Osa de la Vega (Spain)
description: Five horizontal stripes of red, white, blue, white and green in the proportions 4:1:2:1:4.
history: The flag was published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha no. 46 of 15 September 1995: a rectangular flag of 2:3 divided horizontally into five stripes of 1/3 red, 1/12 white, 1/6 blue, 1/12 white and 1/3 green; it closely resembles the flag of The Gambia without any connection between the two places.
